item.title: [AAPL Neutral (-0.13)] Apple App Store rate proceeding halted by Supreme Court for now
item.description:
Sentiment: AAPL Neutral (-0.13)
The Supreme Court has temporarily paused proceedings in the Apple App Store antitrust case, granting Apple a one-day reprieve. Justice Elena Kagan issued an administrative stay to allow the high court more time to consider Apple's request for a longer-term halt to lower court actions. Apple is appealing a civil-contempt finding for defying a 2021 injunction related to developer fees.

item.title: [NVDA Neutral (+0.14)] It's one year to Intel becoming a 'US government company', what has this meant for the chip giant
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Neutral (+0.14)
One year ago, the US government acquired a 9.9% equity stake in Intel for $8.9 billion, making it the largest single shareholder in the chip giant. This move, part of a broader initiative to take equity positions in 30 publicly traded companies, aims to restore the U.S.'s domestic manufacturing capacity and secure critical national technology infrastructure. While government backing strengthens Intel's position as a trusted supplier, it also raises concerns among analysts regarding potential political interference, regulatory conflicts, and the impact on shareholder returns.

item.description:
